title: Family Patio Dining, Plaid Table Coffee Pot - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor family snapshot taken under a covered patio or screened porch, stamped 'OCT 55' at the top edge. Several family members and friends sit around a table laid with a checkered plaid tablecloth, featuring coffee cups, condiment jars, and a prominent metal coffee percolator. A young woman in a sleeveless dress smiles softly in the foreground, with an affectionate hand resting on her shoulder. The background reveals mid-century suburban homes and a backyard swing set, evoking post-WWII American suburban community and domestic life.
